function_declarations.name: create_todoist_tasks
function_declarations.description: Batch create tasks in Todoist categorized under appropriate projects with priorities and due dates.

tasks.description: A list of tasks to create in Todoist.

content.description: The title or main content of the task.

project_name.description: Target Todoist project name (e.g. 'Odak & Gelişim', 'Inbox', 'Work'). Defaults to 'Odak & Gelişim' if omitted.

due_string.description: Natural language due date/time expression (e.g. 'today', 'tomorrow at 15:00', 'every monday at 09:00', 'in 2 days').

priority.description: Priority level of the task from 1 (normal/p4) to 4 (urgent/p1). Default is 1.

description.description: Detailed description, notes, checklist, or markdown context for the task.

parent_id.description: Bu görevi belirtilen Todoist görev ID'sinin alt görevi (subtask) yapar (opsiyonel).

deadline_date.description: Opsiyonel resmi son teslim tarihi (deadline), YYYY-MM-DD formatında (ör. '2026-09-01'). due_string'den farklıdır: due_string görevin ne zaman yapılacağını belirtir, deadline_date ise Todoist'in ayrı 'Deadline' (son teslim tarihi) alanını ayarlar.
